instance_note: candidate_key = sha256 of the canonical candidate; identifies the problem instance

configuration.name: W105 C* SETTLING EXTENSION diagnostic -- BASELINE (C2 + phi_cal 0.985 + soh_min 0.70): the case file alone (AA keep_memory declared) with the ESS ageing parameters declared, the convergence-depth tight tail DECLARED ENABLED (compl_inf_tol 1e-6, certifying cycles only), post-certification: persist the certified TSO/DSO models only
configuration.note: W104's configuration (spec 1a7483ef = the recert ddd6cd44) unchanged; the entry declares settling_extension (keyed) instead of settling_continuation; cap 287; persist_certified_models as W104; no option (b); concurrency 1

objective_convention: gross_operational_cost: settlement-EXCLUDED gross operational cost (the oracle cost convention); net_operational_recourse = gross minus terminal salvage credit

bar.definition: max over the last 10 cycles of |gross_operational_cost[k] - gross_operational_cost[k-1]| (settlement-excluded gross cost; the predecessor of the first window row is taken from the full trajectory; a step is unavailable when cycle k-1 is absent or either gross value is None)

bar_net_recourse_step_reported.definition: max objective_change_abs over the last 10 cycles (production: |net_operational_recourse[k] - net_operational_recourse[k-1]|, shared_resources_planning.py:2849/2814; NET of the terminal salvage credit; reported, not the bar)

settlement_remainder.definition: recourse_components.interface_settlement_total: T_TSO + sum(T_DSO), the non-cancelling interface settlement at the terminal point, excluded from the cost

solve_profile.identity: observed == base + sum over network-failure events of [recovery_attempted] + [tier2_attempted]; unsupported when an ESSO recovery event or an 'indeterminate' network event exists
solve_profile.derivation: (1 + n_dso) * n_years * n_days + n_esso_nodes, per cycle, from the planning object
solve_profile.rounds_note: one initialization round + cycles_run ADMM cycles

recovered_only_identity.note: pre-W35 rule, REPORTED not gated: credits retries only to RECOVERED blocks, so an unrecovered block's attempts go uncounted (78a9b230)

peak_rss.units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (ru_maxrss)
peak_rss.semantics: child_python_process = RUSAGE_SELF of the evaluation process at record time (the evaluation's own peak); production_state = the same measure taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning; solver_subprocesses = RUSAGE_CHILDREN max over the IPOPT executables this evaluation launched; when a post-certification step ran, child_python_process includes it (the ADMM run alone is production_state)

readback_pre_run.method: numerical read-back from the built rows (model_variant_readback) against the declaration's closed forms; on probe models

ess_ageing_readback_terminal.method: numerical read-back from the built rows (model_variant_readback) against the declaration's closed forms; on clones of the given models
